# JIWhiskey

> Premium Irish whiskey, triple distilled and double casked, from the house of Joyce. Death before dishonour.

JIWhiskey is a premium Irish whiskey brand founded in 2022 by Dougie Joyce, founder of 3D Fight Club (bare-knuckle boxing) and DJ Gym Wear. The whiskey is triple distilled, double casked, 40% ABV, bottled at 700ml, distilled, matured and bottled in Ireland. The brand traces its name to the Joyce family of Connacht, one of the Tribes of Galway, and to the Irish Traveller community. The range includes the signature JIWhiskey Classic and JIWhiskey Orange.

## Notes

- Age-restricted product (18+). Site enforces an age gate on entry.
- Related ventures: 3D Fight Club (bare-knuckle boxing promotion), DJ Gym Wear.
- Trade, wholesale and bulk enquiries welcomed; MOQs and pricing discussed on request.
